name: End-to-End Product Engineering
description: Initialize project knowledge, then orchestrate a product from discovery through production operations.

steps.purpose: Inspect the repository and initialize or reconcile .ai/ and .agents/ before substantial product work.
Assess the current phase, coordinate lifecycle workstreams and enforce evidence-based gates.

notes: This workflow is a composition specification, not an automated runner.
For brownfield projects, assess completed phases and resume at the earliest incomplete or failed gate.
A failed blocking gate prevents dependent phases unless the accountable human owner records an explicit exception.
Production deployment always requires explicit human approval.
